gotchas: On www.gog.com, JOIN GOG opens the form inside an iframe from login.gog.com; open login.gog.com/register top-level (signupUrl) so sign-in fills can reach the fields.
Three fields: email, a username (handle you choose; type it as plain text, then record it with set_login_username once the site accepts it), password. No checkbox.
A reCAPTCHA checkbox appears after the first submit ("captcha" error, fields cleared). The account owner solves it via challenge handoff; then re-fill all three fields and submit again.
Success: the form disappears and a "Welcome to GOG.com" mail arrives. No email code or link was needed to sign in afterwards.
